{{Quote|Proceed to transport ID-83 for the Naval Academy on Carida.|Drawd Munbrin, to Han Solo|<ref name="Solo Cadet 1" />}}
'''ID-83''' was the designation of [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], a [[transport]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[13 BBY]], it was in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] scheduled to depart of the [[Carida Academy|Naval Academy]] on [[Carida]]. [[Imperial Recruitment Officer]] [[Chief]] [[Drawd Munbrin]] informed the recently recruited [[Han Solo]] to proceed to the transport.<ref name="Solo" />
